title: Alcubierre's 1994 faster-than-light solution
summary: Karl Nell tells of Alcubierre's 1994 faster-than-light solution, about 1994 at Mexico (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Miguel alcir a Mexican postgraduate student University of Mexico in 1994 solved Einstein's equations for an effective faster than light mechanism

But it is interesting because Miguel
Alcubieri did this proof that
theoretically, even within general
relativity, you could get faster than
light travel if you do have negative
energy.
tellings.difference: Stresses that the proof needs negative energy and leaves out the University of Mexico detail.
tellings.link_reason: Same story: Miguel Alcubierre's 1994 proof that general relativity allows faster-than-light travel.

as_told.title: Alcubierre's proof of faster-than-light warp travel

tellings.quote: I don't know if you know who Miguel Alubieri is. He's at the University of Mexico and he figured out a way, you know, for faster than light travel within the scope of general relativity.
tellings.difference: Places Alcubierre at the University of Mexico and pairs his proof with Sonny White's Casimir-effect chip at NASA.
tellings.link_reason: The quoted passage is Jesse Michels describing Alcubierre's proof that faster-than-light travel is possible within general relativity. That is the same claim as the Alcubierre 1994 story.
